title: Arena
description: A mod for fighting on any battlefield and 5 classes! PvP or PvE, your choice!
body:
Important:
- This mod modifies loot tables for Zombies, Skeletons, Creepers, Spiders, Husks, and Endermen. You are strongly discouraged from using this on your main file.
- This mod will not build the arena on it's own. Use the `/arena` command.
- There is no bug report page.

This mod adds 5 classes (You can use `/arena play last_stand no_arena` to see in singleplayer.) and in `last_stand` mode, monsters will automatically spawn for you yo fight them. In `no_arena` mode, no arena will be built, instead, the pre existing terrain will be treated as the arena. If you use no_arena AND last_stand, no_arena should come after.

The 5 classes added are:
Elementor
Valkyrie
Diviner
Pyromancer
Warrior.

Rubies (dropped by monsters, last stand only.) can be used to craft upgrades and items.

Have fun!
(Warning: Compatibility not gaurenteed for all versions.)
